2607.00860.title: Meta-Transfer Learning for mmWave Beam Alignment
2607.00860.paper_summary: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) beam alignment plays a critical role in next-generation wireless systems, yet its efficient implementation remains challenging. Meta-learning and transfer learning have been explored to enable deep learning-based beam prediction models to rapidly adapt to unseen environments; however, existing meta-learning approaches adapt the entire network and are trained from random initialization, leading to a large number of updated parameters and a high meta-training cost, while transfer learning approaches restrict adaptation to part of the network but do not exploit episodic meta-learning, which explicitly trains the model over multiple tasks, to optimize the adaptation process itself. To overcome these limitations, we propose MTL-BA, a meta-transfer learning framework for beam alignment in millimeter-wave multiple-input single-output (MISO) systems that freezes a pre-trained convolutional backbone and meta-learns only lightweight Scale-and-Shift (SS) adapters together with a classifier head. Warm-starting from the pre-trained model and restricting adaptation to the SS adapters and classifier head reduce both the adaptation cost and the meta-training budget without sacrificing prediction performance. Simulation results on the DeepMIMO ray-tracing dataset show that MTL-BA matches the accuracy and spectral efficiency of full fine-tuning across various SNR levels despite updating approximately $17\times$ fewer parameters than both full fine-tuning and Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML), outperforms last-layer fine-tuning while updating a comparable number of parameters, and approaches MAML's performance while requiring $60\%$ fewer meta-training epochs.
2607.00860.paper_summary_zh: 毫米波（mmWave）波束對準在下一代無線系統中扮演著關鍵角色，但其有效實施仍然具有挑戰性。已經探索了元學習和遷移學習，以使基於深度學習的波束預測模型能夠快速適應未見環境；然而，現有的元學習方法適應整個網絡並從隨機初始化進行訓練，導致大量更新的參數和高昂的元訓練成本，而遷移學習方法則限制了適應僅限於網絡的一部分，但未利用情節元學習，這明確地在多個任務上訓練模型，以優化適應過程本身。為了克服這些限制，我們提出了MTL-BA，一個用於毫米波多輸入單輸出（MISO）系統的波束對準的元遷移學習框架，該框架凍結了一個預訓練的卷積主幹，並僅對輕量級的縮放和移位（SS）適配器以及分類器頭進行元學習。從預訓練模型開始熱啟動，並將適應限制在SS適配器和分類器頭上，減少了適應成本和元訓練預算，而不犧牲預測性能。在DeepMIMO光線追蹤數據集上的模擬結果顯示，MTL-BA在各種信噪比（SNR）水平下的準確性和光譜效率與全面微調相匹配，儘管更新的參數約為全面微調和模型無關元學習（MAML）的$17\times$更少，並且在更新相似數量的參數時超越了最後一層微調，並在需要$60\%$更少的元訓練輪次的情況下接近MAML的性能。
2607.00860.author: Ahmet Nuri Cevik et.al.
